scripts.build:static: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const files=fs.readdirSync("audio").filter(f=>/\.(mp3|mp4|m4a|wav)$/i.test(f)).sort(); fs.mkdirSync("public/data",{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync("public/data/library.json", JSON.stringify({files: files.map(name=>({name, url: "./audio/"+encodeURIComponent(name)}))}, null, 2)); console.log("Static library updated.");'
